result.summary: uucode is a Zig Unicode library whose build.zig generates a small build-config source file from user options. It also compiles and runs a host generator that turns the bundled UCD files into lookup tables. I checked build.zig and build.zig.zon and found no network access, no downloads, no access to secrets or files outside the package, no persistence, and no obfuscated or encoded payloads.

findings.title: Build-time code generator executable is run
findings.detail: build.zig compiles src/generate.zig into a host executable (uucode_generate) and runs it during the build, with the package root as working directory. It reads the Unicode Character Database files listed in ucd/.gitignore and writes tables.zig into the Zig build cache. This is a normal codegen step for a Unicode table library. The generator source and the ucd data files are not part of this surface, so this review cannot confirm what they do.

findings.title: Build options can inject source into the generated config
findings.detail: The -Dbuild_config.zig option accepts raw Zig source. The values of -Dfields* are interpolated into generated Zig source without escaping. Only the person invoking the build controls these inputs, so this is not a supply-chain risk.

findings.title: ucd/.gitignore embedded to list input files
findings.detail: build.zig embeds ucd/.gitignore at build time and uses it only as a list of UCD input filenames, which become cache-invalidation inputs.
